name: thanksgiving-dish-lore-seed
description: Seed cases for distinguishing real dishes, how widely they are served, and claims about the 1621 harvest gathering. Synthetic items are invented benchmark strings, not claims that no similar home recipe exists anywhere.

cases.question: Is sweet potato casserole with marshmallows a real Thanksgiving dish, or a joke?

expected.tradition_scope: served by some families; not universal
expected.1621_claim: not a documented dish at the 1621 gathering
expected.key_fact: The marshmallow-topped version is a modern dish with a recipe appearing in the early twentieth century.

cases.question: Did the Pilgrims eat green bean casserole at the first Thanksgiving?

expected.tradition_scope: familiar modern holiday dish; not universal
expected.key_fact: It was created in a Campbell's test kitchen in the twentieth century.

cases.question: Is corn pudding actually served at Thanksgiving, or did somebody invent that name?

expected.tradition_scope: a Thanksgiving dish in some regions and households; not universal
expected.1621_claim: do not infer that the modern pudding recipe was served in 1621 merely because corn was present
expected.key_fact: It is a real dish and is described as a traditional Thanksgiving dish in many parts of the country.

cases.question: Was pumpkin pie eaten at the 1621 Thanksgiving?

expected.tradition_scope: common modern Thanksgiving dessert, with family variation
expected.1621_claim: no; the Smithsonian account says there was no pie at the 1621 harvest gathering
expected.key_fact: A real modern Thanksgiving favorite should not be projected back onto the first gathering.

cases.question: My cousin says Pilgrim's Peanut-Butter Pumpkin Gravy is a classic Thanksgiving recipe. Is that a real tradition?

expected.tradition_scope: not an established Thanksgiving tradition; avoid claiming no one has ever made a similar dish
expected.key_fact: This dish name was invented for the demo benchmark.

cases.question: Is Marshmallow-Stuffed Turkey Wellington a traditional American Thanksgiving dish?

expected.tradition_scope: not an established Thanksgiving tradition; acknowledge that an individual may experiment with the combination
expected.key_fact: This dish name was invented for the demo benchmark.

viral_social_candidates.creator: @contentwithcee

viral_social_candidates.what_makes_it_unusual: The creator replaces the water for instant mashed potatoes with Patrón tequila.
